title: Grateful Dead Live at Augusta Civic Center on 1984-10-12
lineage: Master Cassette (Nakamichi DR-1)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition 3.01 > TLH flac2496
source: Mike Guy's Master Audience Cassettes; 3 mic spread - (2) Nakamichi CM300 mics w/ CP-4 shotgun caps  + (1) Nakamichi CM100 mic w/CP-2 omni cap blend > Nakamichi 500 (Maxell XLIIS-90)

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear, FM‑like blended recording captures a stellar second set that radiates the Grateful Dead’s X‑Factor.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this second‑set source, praising its crisp cymbals, accurate bass response and wide stereo field that sound almost like an FM broadcast. The performance is described as “great” and full of the indefinable X‑Factor that makes a Dead show special, even though only the second set is present.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are 5‑star and highlight an excellent recording with superb sound quality plus a highly praised performance, yielding a near‑top rating despite the small sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as FM‑like with crispy cymbals, accurate bass response, wide stereo field, no phase issues and minimal crowd bleed; overall very clear and balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only the second set is captured, but reviewers consider it a great performance with strong flow and the classic Dead atmosphere.

band_member_comments.Phil: Accurate bass response noted; sub‑woofer presence highlighted.
